summary: If Nora is restarted while building you something, she now comes back and says she lost track of it — instead of leaving «I'm working on it» hanging forever.
details: She says she lost the thread and to ask again. She does not claim it failed and does not claim it worked, because she genuinely cannot tell which.
If the room is mid-conversation when she comes back, she waits rather than interrupting.
limitations: The half-built thing itself is still lost — the request has to be made again.
She tells you once. If that message cannot be delivered it is not retried, though the failure is recorded.
